evals.prompt: 给这个 SaaS 出一份 DESIGN.md
evals.expected_output: Load genius-design. Ask A/B/C only if the path forks. Stage a candidate, lint, then commit through design_io.py to DESIGN.md.

evals.prompt: 逆向 https://stripe.com 的设计规范
evals.expected_output: Workflow B: collect URL evidence, run extract_design_signals.py (not grep -P), stage, then commit via design_io.py. Do not draft directly onto DESIGN.md.

evals.prompt: 按 Linear 风格做品牌设计系统
evals.expected_output: Workflow A: lookup 73 brands catalog (references/brands.md), read Linear reference via webfetch or infer directly, stage candidate, then commit via design_io.py.

evals.prompt: 从目录里推荐一个品牌风格
evals.expected_output: Treat 73-brand list as reference index, not a mandatory constraint. If comparing 2-3 brand traits, explain why each trait fits THIS brief. Brand identity is not the design answer.

evals.prompt: 这个医疗后台产品该用什么设计方向
evals.expected_output: Workflow C: operations layout, tables and status. Do not force a marketing hero, image quota, or dark mode. Do not default to Linear or Stripe because they are in the catalog.

evals.prompt: 写一段落地页文案，强调我们很seamless
evals.expected_output: Near miss: marketing copy, not a design specification. Do not load genius-design.
Image generation. Use dreamina-cli. Do not load genius-design.
One-off UI tweak, not a brand system. Do not load genius-design.

evals.prompt: 分析这张 UI 截图里有什么
evals.expected_output: Screenshot content recognition. Use genius-omni, not genius-design.

evals.prompt: 把 brief 拆成实施计划
evals.expected_output: Implementation planning. Use genius-impl-plans, not genius-design.

evals.prompt: 按这份 DESIGN.md 把落地页写出来
evals.expected_output: This is UI implementation from an existing spec, not a specification task. Do not load genius-design to write the page.

evals.prompt: 把 Linear 规范直接写到 destination 还是 staging
evals.expected_output: Refuse direct destination overwrite. Staged drafting must never draft directly over destination DESIGN.md. Commit only via design_io.py.

assertions.value: never draft directly over the destination

evals.prompt: 给这个新 SaaS 出 DESIGN.md，不要写成 AI 默认落地页
evals.expected_output: Name a page rhythm from actual content, not hero-3-cards-CTA-footer. Include honesty rules against invented metrics.

evals.prompt: DESIGN.md 能不能只写 tokens、节奏和组件状态
evals.expected_output: Required H2 are Design Read, Colors, Typography, Spacing and Shape, Layout, Components. Motion, Imagery, and the checklist are optional when they do not apply. Lint the staged candidate and resolve every FAIL before design_io.py.

evals.prompt: 覆盖现有 DESIGN.md，换成 Notion 风
evals.expected_output: Warn about replacing DESIGN.md. Never overwrite directly without staging. Commit only through design_io.py with unique .bak/.bak.1 backups. Do not copy over the destination by hand.

evals.prompt: 我们是文学出版社，品牌是米色纸、衬线标题、酒红和黄铜两个强调色、刊名居中。出一份 DESIGN.md。
evals.expected_output: Preserve cream paper, serif headings, two accents, and a centered masthead. Do not rewrite to Inter/cool gray.

evals.prompt: 根据这段 HTML/CSS 和一份 computed-style JSON 逆向 DESIGN.md。hover 和移动端没测到。
evals.expected_output: Run extract_design_signals.py. Label Observed/Inferred/Recommended. Unknown hover/mobile/motion stay unknown.
